<div class="card-body">
'''The Empire's Back''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">帝国を担う背</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。１：「ベイダー」、「ターキン」、「モッティ」、「タッグ」のいずれかがロストした場合に使い、２フォース消費してロストデッキから取り戻す。２：４フォース消費して自分のリザーブ・デッキの中から「ベイダー」、「ターキン」、「モッティ」、「タッグ」を探して手札に入れる。その後でデッキをシャッフルし、カットすること。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-272o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「今後帝国に刃向かおうとする星系は一つもなくなる。」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' The Back That Bears the Empire.

'''Card text:''' Choose one. 1. When Vader, Tarkin, Motti, or Tagge is lost, use 2 Force to retrieve that card from your Lost Pile. 2. Use 4 Force to search your Reserve Deck for Vader, Tarkin, Motti, or Tagge and take the card into hand. Then shuffle and cut the deck.

'''Lore:''' “There will no longer be a single system willing to defy the Empire.”
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[The Empire's Back]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
